result:
Summary: The ManuRAG framework introduces four distinct strategies for handling multi-modal manufacturing data, each exploring different approaches to indexing and retrieval. ManuRAG1 maintains separate text and image vector databases, using both for retrieval and combining results in a multi-modal language model (MLLM). ManuRAG2 operates exclusively on textual data, representing a high-quality text-only RAG baseline. ManuRAG3 extends ManuRAG1 by prioritizing the retrieval of visual data explicitly referenced within text chunks. ManuRAG4 introduces a unique step in multi-modal data processing by transforming visual data into descriptive text using an MLLM before embedding. The framework explores different strategies for integrating text and image data—whether alignment should occur before embedding, within the embedding space, or after embedding.
